contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' line 1 TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED (24,294.75) on the p2 SUMMARY PAGE, which equals the 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule A pages)' 24,294.75 printed at the foot of all three Schedule A sheets and is repeated at summary lines 4 and 5
contributions.detail: 42 Schedule A rows over three sheets, each sheet gated on its OWN printed page subtotal first: p3 17 rows = 8,915.00 = its printed 'Subtotal for this page'; p4 17 rows = 8,960.00 = its printed subtotal; p5 8 rows = 6,419.75 = its printed subtotal. 8,915.00 + 8,960.00 + 6,419.75 = 24,294.75 = the cycle-scope footer = the cover's promoted PER-PERIOD Column A cell. THE TWO PRINTED FOOTERS CARRY DIFFERENT SCOPES on every sheet (page subtotal vs sum of all pages) and each was reconciled to the right one. Column B Year-to-Date prints the SAME 24,294.75 because this is the filer's first and only report of the cycle (period = year to date), so no cumulative/period distinction arises. THE SUM CLOSES ONLY WITH IN-KIND INCLUDED (4 rows marked '(in kind)' by the filer, 4,890.71) and ONLY WITH THE TWO 'loan to self' LINES INCLUDED (2,919.04): monetary-only gives 19,404.04 and loan-excluded gives 21,375.71, both of which fail. The cover ladder corroborates: line 3 beginning is a SLASHED ZERO (0), line 4 = 24,294.75, line 5 = 24,294.75, line 6 = 24,294.75, line 7 balance at close is a SLASHED ZERO (0).

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' line 2 TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE (24,294.75) on the p2 SUMMARY PAGE, equal to the 'Total Expenditures (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule B pages)' 24,294.75 printed at the foot of all six Schedule B sheets
expenditures.detail: 89 Schedule B rows over six sheets. FOUR OF THE SIX SHEETS CLOSE TO THE CENT against their own printed page subtotals: p7 17 rows = 1,384.67; p8 17 rows = 8,095.30; p9 17 rows = 4,521.09; p11 4 rows = 1,356.50. TWO DO NOT: p6's 17 rows sum to 2,857.56 against a printed subtotal of 2,707.56 (+150.00), and p10's 17 rows sum to 6,235.47 against a printed 6,229.63 (+5.84). Total rows as read 24,450.59 vs the stated 24,294.75, delta +155.84. THE DELTA IS TRACED TO THOSE TWO PAGES BUT IS NOT UNIQUELY ATTRIBUTABLE TO ANY CELL, so nothing was nudged (ADDENDUM C5): the filer's own six page subtotals sum to exactly 24,294.75 and match the cover, so his page-level totals are internally consistent while two of them do not equal the rows he wrote above them. Screening done before retaining the delta: (a) the doubled-band check of ADDENDUM H3 - both pages carry a full 17-rule grid, every band was crop-read individually and none holds two entries; (b) the below-the-last-rule check of ADDENDUM F1.5 - the one-past control on each page rendered the printed 'Subtotal for this page' footer, not an extra entry; (c) the glyph class - this filer's zero and six are the same loop, but no combination of 0/6 re-readings can produce -150.00 or -5.84 (every such change is a multiple of 0.06, and 5.84 is not), so the ambiguity cannot explain either page; (d) the correlated-error screen - this is the filer's only filing in the corpus, so 'not-correlated-by-absence'. Candidate cells on both pages carry needs_review=1.

itemized.in_kind_convention: MONETARY-PLUS-IN-KIND on the contributions side - tested both ways per ADDENDUM G1. Four Schedule A rows are marked '(in kind)' inside the Name of Contributor cell (Nathan Ivie 200.00, Brook Roney 2,000.00, Kay Durfey 2,557.12 and 133.59 = 4,890.71); monetary-only gives 19,404.04 against a stated 24,294.75 and fails, while monetary-plus-in-kind closes exactly. On the expenditures side NO row is marked in-kind by the filer, so every expenditure row is recorded in_kind=false as printed - even the three rows on p10 whose amounts match the in-kind gifts to the cent (2,557.12 / 133.59 / 2,000.00) and are evidently the offsetting entries. The correspondence is noted on those rows and NOT asserted as a form property.
itemized.escalation_note: THE FILER'S ZERO AND HIS SIX ARE THE SAME GLYPH - a loop with a lead-in stroke - and the two can only be told apart by arithmetic. Fourteen amount cells were escalated to 1100-1800 dpi tight crops with the address column excluded. What the escalations established: (1) On p3 three cells carry the ambiguous glyph (rows 11, 14, 17). The other fourteen rows are unambiguous and sum to 8,565.00, so the three must total 350.00; of the eight possible assignments only 200.00 + 100.00 + 50.00 gives 350.00 (the others give 356, 410, 410, 416, 470, 476), so the closure is UNIQUE and the page closes exactly at its printed 8,915.00. My first reading of that page (260 / 100 / 56) summed 66.00 high and was WRONG. (2) The reference instance is the filer's OWN confirmed glyph: p4 row 17 is written identically and must be 200.00 for that page to close at its printed 8,960.00 - the ADDENDUM F6 standard of comparing a disputed digit to the same filer's arithmetically-confirmed instance elsewhere. (3) The same glyph is a genuine SIX at p4 row 6 (60.00) and p5 row 3 (60.00), both proved by their pages closing exactly - so the glyph cannot be resolved by shape in either direction, only by the page's arithmetic. (4) On p6 rows 4, 6, 7 and 9 and on p10 rows 2, 3, 7 and 13 the same ambiguity exists but those two pages do NOT close, so no arithmetic is available to settle them; they are retained as read with needs_review=1. p6 row 7 was cropped at 1800 dpi from the amount column's own left rule and rendered three digits, '224.37', with no bleed from the address column - it is not 24.37. ARITHMETIC CLOSURE OUTRANKS GLYPH READING (GOTCHAS / the Rhodes reversal) and that is exactly what decided every cell that could be decided.

Office Seeking printed simply as 'Sheriff'; party Republican; residence city Santaquin. Report type: '30 Days after withdraw or elimination', signed 5-1-18, clerk stamp '18 MAY 1 AM 8:38. THE AMENDMENT QUESTION IS WHOLLY UNTICKED - neither Yes nor No - an honest BLANK, never read as 'No' (ADDENDUM A4). Single report, no bundle. ELEVEN pages: p1 cover / p2 SUMMARY PAGE / p3-p5 SCHEDULE A / p6-p11 SCHEDULE B, every page classified from its own printed heading; no checklist decoy. FOLIATION: the filer numbers his sheets 'Page 2 of 11' through 'Page 10 of 11' COUNTING THE COVER, and then repeats '10' on the eleventh page - a foliation slip, so the last sheet's own number does not identify it. The cover is the common 2018-era blank ('...FOR COUNTY & LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD CANDIDATES', Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5 & 20A-11-13) while all nine inner sheets are strap-lined '2016 County Commission & Local School Board Candidate' - leftover 2016 stock on a genuinely 2018 filing (utah-template-vintage-year), and note the strapline wording differs from the 2016 sheets seen elsewhere ('County Commission &' rather than 'County &'). Schedule B REUSES Schedule A's heading 'Name of Contributor' over the payee column and there is NO Purpose column, so purpose is honestly blank on all 89 expenditure rows; the columns are assignable by CONTENT (merchants, vendors, real addresses) and the field-shift screen passes. THE DOCUMENT IS UNREDACTED - it is not a *_Redacted.pdf and carries no bars; donor and vendor street lines are visible on the page and are deliberately reduced to city/state at read time (dropped entirely for expenditures).
